transforms.code:
# Setting a speed-loss reason needs the Edit Operations right on this asset, as on the asset's info panel (assetInfo).
	# A guest (not logged in) has none
	security = value['security']
	userCRUD = security['userCRUD'] if security else {}
	if not userCRUD: return False
	if userCRUD.get('isGatewayAdmin'): return True
	entry = userCRUD.get('editOperations') or {}
	if not entry.get('enabled'): return False
	assets = entry.get('assets') or []
	if not assets: return True
	assetPath = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('assetPath', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetId': value['assetId'] or -1})) or ''
	return any(assetPath == a or assetPath.startswith(a + '\\') for a in assets)

# The events behind one line of the Production Counts summary, read again here so they're current after an edit (custom.tick):
	# speed loss (performance events), quality checks (check sheet events scheduled in the range) or maintenance (work order
	# events due in the range, on the asset or a tool mounted on it). Statuses are worked out as countBarChart's custom.events
	# works them out, so the lines match. With onlyMatching, only the line's reasons / status
	# Times in the device's time zone, as the chart shows them
	from java.text import SimpleDateFormat
	from java.util import TimeZone
	def dfmt(d, pattern):
		f = SimpleDateFormat(pattern)
		if value['tz']: f.setTimeZone(TimeZone.getTimeZone(value['tz']))
		return f.format(d)
	p = value['params'] or {}
	kind, assetId, start, end = p.get('kind'), p.get('assetId'), p.get('startDate'), p.get('endDate')
	match = list(p.get('match') or [])
	only = bool(value['only']) and len(match) > 0
	if assetId is None or start is None or end is None: return []
	now = system.date.now()
	t0, t1, tNow = system.date.toMillis(start), system.date.toMillis(end), system.date.toMillis(now)
	fmt = lambda d: dfmt(d, 'MMM d, HH:mm') if d is not None else ''
	text = lambda secs: system.kanoa.utilities.secondsToText(int(secs), {'showSecs': False, 'showDays': False}) or ''
	rows = []
	if kind == 'speedLoss':
		# From a week before the range: getPerformanceEvents filters on the start, and an event can start before the range
		data = system.kanoa.event.getPerformanceEvents({'assetId': assetId, 'startDate': system.date.addDays(start, -7), 'endDate': end})
		if data is None or isinstance(data, basestring): return []
		for e in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(data):
			if e.get('startDate') is None: continue
			active = e.get('isActive') or e.get('endDate') is None
			s = system.date.toMillis(e['startDate'])
			x2 = tNow if active else system.date.toMillis(e['endDate'])
			if min(x2, t1, tNow) <= max(s, t0): continue
			name = e.get('performanceStateName') or 'Unassigned'
			if only and name not in match: continue
			# The end as a time only when it's the same day
			if active: until = 'now'
			elif dfmt(e['startDate'], 'yyyyMMdd') == dfmt(e['endDate'], 'yyyyMMdd'): until = dfmt(e['endDate'], 'HH:mm')
			else: until = fmt(e['endDate'])
			rows.append({'id': e['performanceEventId'], 'sort': s, 'when': '%s to %s' % (fmt(e['startDate']), until),
				'name': name + (' (automatic)' if e.get('autoReason') else ''), 'status': '%s lost' % text(float(e.get('value') or 0) * 60),
				'detail': e.get('note') or ''})
	elif kind == 'checks':
		data = system.kanoa.quality.event.getChkShtEvents({'assetId': assetId, 'startDate': start, 'endDate': end, 'searchDate': 'scheduledDate'})
		if data is None or isinstance(data, basestring): return []
		labels = {'passed': 'Passed', 'failed': 'Failed', 'missed': 'Missed', 'overdue': 'Overdue', 'upcoming': 'Upcoming'}
		for e in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(data):
			state = e['chkShtStateName']
			if state in ('Canceled', 'Disabled') or e['scheduledDate'] is None: continue
			if state in ('Submitted', 'Approved'): status = 'failed' if (e['failedChecks'] or 0) > 0 else 'passed'
			elif state == 'Rejected': status = 'failed'
			elif state in ('Missed', 'Overdue'): status = 'missed'
			else: status = 'upcoming' if system.date.toMillis(e['scheduledDate']) > tNow else 'overdue'
			if only and status not in match: continue
			detail = state or ''
			if e['failedChecks']: detail += ', %d failed check%s' % (e['failedChecks'], '' if e['failedChecks'] == 1 else 's')
			if e['takenDate']: detail += ', taken %s' % fmt(e['takenDate'])
			rows.append({'id': e['chkShtEventId'], 'sort': system.date.toMillis(e['scheduledDate']), 'when': fmt(e['scheduledDate']),
				'name': e['chkShtName'] or '', 'status': labels[status], 'detail': detail})
	elif kind == 'workOrders':
		labels = {'done': 'Done', 'inprogress': 'In progress', 'overdue': 'Overdue', 'missed': 'Missed', 'upcoming': 'Upcoming'}
		for target in p.get('targets') or [{'assetId': assetId, 'name': None}]:
			data = system.kanoa.cmms.getWorkOrderEvents({'assetId': target['assetId'], 'startDate': start, 'endDate': end})
			if data is None or isinstance(data, basestring): continue
			for e in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(data):
				if e['dueDate'] is None: continue
				due = system.date.toMillis(e['dueDate'])
				if due < t0 or due > t1 or e['workOrderEventStatusName'] == 'Cancelled': continue
				category, name = e['workOrderEventStatusCategoryName'], e['workOrderEventStatusName']
				if name == 'Missed': status = 'missed'
				elif category == 'Closed': status = 'done'
				elif due < tNow: status = 'overdue'
				elif category == 'In Progress': status = 'inprogress'
				else: status = 'upcoming'
				if only and status not in match: continue
				detail = ', '.join([x for x in [name, e['maintenanceTypeName'], ('on %s' % target['name']) if target.get('name') else None,
					('assigned to %s' % e['assignedUser']) if e['assignedUser'] else None] if x])
				rows.append({'id': e['workOrderEventId'], 'sort': due, 'when': fmt(e['dueDate']),
					'name': ('%s %s' % (e['workOrderEventName'] or '', e['title'] or '')).strip(), 'status': labels[status], 'detail': detail})
	rows.sort(key=lambda r: r['sort'])
	return rows

return {'speedLoss': 'Click an event to set its reason.', 'checks': 'Click a check to open it.',
		'workOrders': 'Click a work order to open it.'}.get(value, '')

config.script:
# Each event opens in the editor its own screens use (event.row: the row's index in the data, which has the id the columns
	# don't show)
	data = self.props.data or []
	row = data[event.row] if event.row is not None and 0 <= event.row < len(data) else None
	if not row or row['id'] is None: return
	kind = self.view.params.value.kind
	if kind == 'speedLoss':
		if not self.view.custom.canEdit:
			system.kanoa.toast.show({'id': 'speedLossLogIn', 'type': 'warning', 'message': system.util.translate('Log in with the Edit Operations right to set a speed loss reason', self.session.props.locale)})
			return
		system.perspective.openPopup('speedLossReason', 'kanoa/mes/asset/operation/speedLoss/speedLossReason',
			{'value': {'assetId': self.view.params.value.assetId, 'performanceEventId': row['id']}},
			title='Speed Loss', draggable=True, resizable=True, showCloseIcon=True, viewportBound=True)
	elif kind == 'checks':
		system.perspective.openPopup('productionSummaryCheck', 'kanoa/qds/schedule/chkShtEventEditor',
			{'chkShtEventId': row['id'], 'value': {'navBack': False, 'previewMode': False}},
			title=row['name'], draggable=True, resizable=True, showCloseIcon=True, viewportBound=True)
	elif kind == 'workOrders':
		system.perspective.openPopup('productionSummaryWorkOrder', 'kanoa/cmms/events/workOrderEventEditor',
			{'values': {'workOrderEventId': row['id']}},
			title=row['name'], draggable=True, resizable=True, showCloseIcon=True, viewportBound=True)
	return

transforms.code:
# Column titles for the kind of event
	titles = {'speedLoss': ('From', 'Reason', 'Lost', 'Note'), 'checks': ('Scheduled', 'Check sheet', 'Result', 'State'),
		'workOrders': ('Due', 'Work order', 'Status', 'Detail')}.get(value, ('When', 'Name', 'Status', 'Detail'))
	# Minimum widths that fit the popup with its scroll bar (no horizontal scrolling); each column grows to fill it
	widths = (180, 220, 130, 240)
	cols = []
	for field, title, width in zip(('when', 'name', 'status', 'detail'), titles, widths):
		cols.append({'field': field, 'header': {'title': title}, 'width': width, 'grow': 1, 'strictWidth': False, 'sortable': True, 'visible': True,
			'render': 'auto', 'justify': 'auto', 'align': 'center', 'resizable': True, 'editable': False})
	return cols
